visual_review: Before: a tangled diagonal person and paddle over a lopsided boat. Now: a seated person (r4 head with an exact 8 gap above an upright torso) holds the arm level to a 3:8 paddle whose blade dips in at the gunwale of a flat canoe with raised tips.
